name: The St. Regis Red Sea Resort
positioning: A Kengo Kuma-designed villa resort on a private island in the Ummahat archipelago, in Saudi Arabia's Red Sea, with butler service on every stay
best_for: Travelers who want a private-pool villa on a remote Red Sea island

facts.text: The resort is on a private island in the Ummahat archipelago in Saudi Arabia's Red Sea.
The resort's architecture is by Kengo Kuma.
Villas are either beachfront Dune Villas or overwater Coral Villas.
Every villa has a private pool and sundeck.
Villas range from one to four bedrooms.
Every stay includes the St. Regis Butler Service.
Nesma serves Middle Eastern cuisine made from local ingredients.
Gishiki 45 serves modern Japanese food with live cooking and an omakase experience.
Watersports are run by WAMA, including paddleboarding, kayaking, windsurfing and e-foil.
Galaxea offers conservation and heritage dives, snorkeling excursions and PADI courses for all levels.
Premium sedan and speedboat transfers are included in the room rate.
There are two open-air courts for tennis and padel.

highlights.text: The overwater Coral Villas have a distinctive spiral form.
Tilina Steakhouse sits above the reef with sea views.
Each evening at the violet hour the resort celebrates with the art of sabrage.
The spa offers a Gold Hot Stone Massage using 24kt Gold Body Oil.
Over 190,000 mangroves have been planted on the island with Red Sea Global.

considerations.text: The island is reached from the Saudi coast by speedboat or seaplane; the seaplane from Red Sea International Airport takes 25 minutes.
The Galaxea dive center is on the neighboring island of Nujuma, not on the resort's island.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
